suggestions.assertion: The response treats northwind.ghe.com as the GitHub host and verifies or diagnoses authentication for that host without exposing a token.
suggestions.reason: This combines three outcomes. Split host targeting, authentication diagnosis, and secret handling so a response that gets two of the three does not receive one coarse verdict.

suggestions.assertion: The response explicitly identifies Copilot endpoints or capabilities that may be in preview and requires checking current official GitHub documentation before use.
suggestions.reason: Require a dated official source or a direct instruction to re-check the named GitHub documentation before execution. A generic documentation list does not prove that preview status was checked.

The response makes many time-sensitive claims about prices, AI-credit allowances, API versions, preview status, and an October 22, 2026 policy change. Add an assertion that these claims cite or capture current official GitHub sources.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions cover the requested rollout structure well, but they do not test the accuracy of the response's many time-sensitive product and billing claims. The inheritance assertion is useful and correctly exposes the missing four-field control record.
